name: Descrybe Legal Engine
description: The Descrybe Connector gives Claude access to legal research tools for working with primary law. It can help analyze a research question, search cases by legal concept or exact wording, find cases from citations or messy references, extract authorities from pasted text, retrieve summaries, case PDFs, and focused opinion passages, search statutes and regulations, check case treatment status, find citing cases, and verify quoted language against known cases.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Descrybe Legal Engine to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Descrybe Legal Engine to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.descrybe.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Descrybe Legal Engine MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Descrybe Legal Engine lists 13 MCP tools, including analyze_legal_question, search_cases_by_concept, search_case_text, find_case_from_reference, extract_case_references, get_case_details, get_case_pdf, get_case_passages, get_case_summary, search_laws_and_rules, check_case_status, and find_cases_that_cite.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Descrybe Legal Engine?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Descrybe Legal Engine in search-research on the Manufact MCP catalog include Agentic Atlas: Agent Design Patterns, common-practice, GDELT Cloud, BookDNA, and Lyon.

_published_faq.name: Does Descrybe Legal Engine MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: Descrybe Legal Engine requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Descrybe Legal Engine is developed by Descrybe. It is listed as partner on the Claude connector directory.
